profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Caffeine dependent, and I like code.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed in C++ to implement a project that focused on obtaining quality clusters for the play app store.
- Used various internal API’s and was able to improve the quality of clusters that were being created by filtering out 75% of the clusters exported for evaluation based on their metrics.
- Worked to improve Play's search and the method for retrieving/creating clusters.

positions.title: Developer Intern
positions.description: Implemented a WebMethods based tool affecting 100+ people for integrations to be stored in a Service Oriented Architecture registry. I carefully created a data model along with creating analyses and custom asset types to fit the needs of the integrations and the business unit. I also actively reached out for a side project where I was able to gain experience in application security by developing scripts for various applications and then scanning them to ensure that they were not vulnerable.

positions.title: School Activities Assistant
positions.description: Supervised children. Creatively planned and ran activities. Always kept a positive and happy atmosphere. Always responsible, trustworthy and motivated.

honors.title: 2016 Grace Hopper Conference Scholar
honors.issuer: Issued by Anita Borg Institute · Oct 2016

honors.title: Valedictorian
honors.description: I ended high school with a cumulative 4.26 GPA.
honors.issuer: Issued by Las Plumas High School · Jun 2013

volunteerExperiences.description: Build.com held a section for 30 girls, ranging in age from 6th grade to 12th grade. It was at Chico High, which is a local high school. I walked around and answered questions that the girls came across when doing their assignments. In addition to that, I designed a few exercises for them to do outside of their normal environment, which introduced them to beginner Python programming and an online interpreter.

The Chico section hosted its annual STEM-education outreach event, “Imagineer Day” and invited children to come participate in different engineering labs. I designed, customized, and organized an engineering lab for 130+ children during a local outreach event for the community.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description: Designed, developed and implemented a website that is about me. It contains a blog, information about my schooling, projects, extracurricular activities and other interests of mine.

organizations.name: Upsilon Pi Epsilon (Computer Science Honor Society)
organizations.description:
Spring 2016: Vice President of the Chico Section
I have volunteered 180+ hours in a lower division computer science lab. I was on the student interview panel for 3 future faculty hires; where I spoke with each candidate and raised questions that I had to them.

organizations.name: Association for Computing Machinery
organizations.description: Attend weekly meetings that have an emphasis on designing and developing programs, and   furthering knowledge and passion in Computer Science by investigating various algorithms. Planned presentations to increase members professional development skills
